@@ -744,0 +744,8 @@
+#   - TLS cipher suites can also be disabled using components of the cipher
+#     suite, which include the key exchange algorithm, the bulk encryption
+#     algorithm, the MAC algorithm, and the PRF or hash algorithm. For example,
+#     the key exchange algorithm "ECDH_ECDSA" will disable all cipher suites
+#     that contain ECDH_ECDSA as the key exchange algorithm. Similarly, the
+#     bulk encryption algorithm "3DES_EDE_CBC" will disable all cipher suites
+#     that contain 3DES_EDE_CBC as the bulk encryption algorithm.
+#
